about: Lock Fourteen: ten pages of four panels on the Steeple Wyke layouts; pictures are media/p<n>-<knot>.jpg, sounds media/sfx/. Cast ids are in ../steeplewyke/bible/characters.json. 'tiny' is a short ambient loop (tools/tiny-loop.sh from a kling clip, start frame only); 'peek' is the canary (the photo-novel skill's Peek panels).
place: The Wyke Arm, a restored canal branch in a Cotswold valley below the village of Steeple Wyke, in October: a flight of old brick and stone locks with black-and-white balance beams, a towpath, willows.

pages.title: Lock fourteen
pages.bed: a canal lock in a quiet Cotswold valley on an October morning: water trickling through lock gates, a moorhen calling, distant rooks, a light wind in willows, no traffic

panels.alt: Lock fourteen, full to the top of its gates, with police tape across the balance beam and mist on the water.
panels.prompt: A narrow canal lock of old brick and stone, full of still dark water right up to the top of its black-and-white wooden gates, on an October morning with low mist on the water. Blue-and-white police tape runs from a black-and-white balance beam to a wooden fence post. Willows and a towpath. Below the lock, far off, a green narrowboat moored.
panels.sound: water lapping softly against lock gates, police tape fluttering in a light wind, a moorhen

tiny.prompt: Locked-off camera, almost a still photograph. Only the low mist drifts very slowly over the still water and the police tape stirs slightly. No camera movement.

panels.alt: A police exhibit bag on the lockside holding a windlass with a plastic hire-company tag.
panels.prompt: Close-up on wet stone coping at the edge of a canal lock: a clear plastic police evidence bag with a printed label, lying on the stone. Inside the bag, an old iron canal windlass, an L-shaped handle with a square socket, with a small green plastic tag tied to it.
panels.sound: a plastic evidence bag rustling, a police radio murmuring at a distance

panels.alt: Clive Amory by the top gate of the lock, holding two paper cups of coffee.
panels.prompt: CLIVE stands by the top gate of a canal lock on a misty October morning, holding two paper cups of takeaway coffee, one held out towards the viewer, a kind careful smile. A canal windlass sticks out of his fleece pocket. Behind him the black-and-white balance beam of the lock gate.
panels.sound: a man's footsteps on gravel, steam from coffee, water trickling through a gate

panels.alt: Lock fifteen empty; the stretch of canal below it low, with a strip of wet brick showing and a work boat aground on the mud.
panels.prompt: A wide view along a canal towpath to the next lock up the hill, which stands empty with both pairs of gates shut. The stretch of canal in front of it is low: a strip of dark wet brickwork a foot high shows along the bank above the waterline, and a small blue steel work boat sits tilted on the mud, its mooring ropes taut.
panels.sound: an empty lock dripping, water trickling over a weir, a crow

pages.title: The flight and the lock cottage
pages.bed: a canal towpath beside a flight of locks with a small cottage: wind, water running over weirs, a door creaking, a kettle somewhere inside, birdsong

panels.alt: The towpath climbing beside the flight of locks, each paddle post wrapped in a chain, and the lock cottage below.
panels.prompt: A canal towpath climbing a gentle hill beside a flight of three restored locks with black-and-white balance beams. On each lock, the iron paddle gear posts are wrapped in a heavy chain with a brass padlock. At the foot, a small whitewashed lock-keeper's cottage with a slate roof and a small plain painted wooden sign with no words. October afternoon light.
panels.sound: wind across a canal, water running over weirs, a chain clinking against an iron post

panels.alt: A dark coat hung on a hook in a clear plastic bag, two brass keys on a ring, and a typed list on the wall.
panels.prompt: Inside a small canal office: a dark waxed coat hangs on a wall hook inside a clear plastic police property bag. On a table below it lies a ring with two small brass padlock keys, one with a paper label tied on. A torch and a brown leather wallet beside them.
panels.sound: a plastic bag rustling, keys jingling on a ring, a wall clock ticking

panels.alt: Kit Rowe at the door of the flat above the lock cottage, a mug in her hand and a windlass in her belt.
panels.prompt: KIT stands in the open doorway at the top of an outside wooden stair of a small canal cottage, a mug of tea in one hand, guarded and tired, looking down at the viewer.
panels.sound: a wooden door opening, a mug set down, a young woman sighing

panels.alt: A minutes book open on a table, in round handwriting, with a small pencil drawing of a lock gate with a face.
panels.prompt: Close-up of an open hardback minutes book on an office table, pages of neat round blue handwriting, too small to read, and at the bottom of the page a small pencil doodle of a canal lock gate with a cartoon face. A biro and a mug ring.
panels.sound: pages turning, a biro on a table, rain starting on a window

pages.title: Wren
pages.bed: a narrowboat moored on a quiet canal: water slapping a steel hull, a rope creaking, ducks, a breeze, a radio very low inside the boat

panels.alt: Maaike van Dam at the side hatch of the boat, holding out her phone.
panels.prompt: MAAIKE leans out of the open side hatch of a green narrowboat, holding her phone out towards the viewer with the screen showing, direct and serious. Geraniums in a tin on the roof above her.
panels.sound: a hatch sliding open, a phone tapped, water against a hull

panels.alt: Joost van Dam on the roof of the boat, coiling a rope.
panels.prompt: JOOST stands on the roof of a green narrowboat, coiling a mooring rope, not looking at the viewer, his jaw set.
panels.sound: a rope being coiled on a steel roof, a man breathing out

panels.alt: A phone screen showing a night photograph of an empty lock, and on the lockside a small figure with a torch.
panels.prompt: Close-up of a smartphone screen held in a woman's hand, showing a dark night photograph taken by headlamp: an empty canal lock chamber, a narrowboat leaving through open bottom gates, and on the lockside above a small distant figure of a man in a dark coat holding a torch, pointing.
panels.sound: a phone screen tapped, a swipe, a woman's quiet voice off

panels.alt: The green hire boat Wren moored by a NO MOORING sign, with geraniums in a tin on the roof.
panels.prompt: A long green hire narrowboat moored at a canal lock landing beside a small white sign on a post that reads NO MOORING, with red geraniums in a tin on its roof and a bicycle on the roof. Morning light, willows, a lock beyond.
panels.sound: water slapping a steel hull, a mooring rope creaking, ducks

tiny.prompt: Locked-off camera, almost a still photograph. Only small ripples move on the water and the geraniums stir slightly in a breeze. No camera movement.

pages.title: Mill Lane
pages.bed: a quiet village lane and the inside of a small house: a clock ticking, rain on a window, a kettle going cold, a car passing slowly outside

panels.alt: A stone semi on a village lane, with a rain gauge on a post in the front garden.
panels.prompt: A honey-coloured stone semi-detached house on a quiet Cotswold village lane on a grey October morning, with a tidy front garden and a small plastic rain gauge on a wooden post by the gate. Wet leaves on the path.
panels.sound: rain dripping, a garden gate clicking, a distant car

panels.alt: Annette Strand at her kitchen table, a full cup of tea in front of her.
panels.prompt: ANNETTE sits very upright at a small kitchen table, hands folded, a full cup of tea untouched in front of her, looking straight at the viewer, composed and exact. A laptop closed beside her. Grey window light.
panels.sound: a teaspoon set on a saucer, a kitchen clock ticking, a fridge hum

panels.alt: A box file marked GATES open on a desk: a bank statement with two lines ringed in pencil.
panels.prompt: Close-up on a study desk: an open grey box file with a handwritten label, papers inside, on top a printed bank statement with two lines ringed in pencil and a pencil note in the margin, too small to read. A sharpened pencil and reading glasses beside it.
panels.sound: papers shuffled, a box file lid, a pencil on paper

panels.alt: A small notebook on a hall table, open at columns of pencil numbers, a pencil in its spine.
panels.prompt: Close-up of a small worn pocket notebook open on a polished hall table, pages filled with neat columns of numbers in pencil, a short pencil tucked into the spine, beside a bowl of keys.
panels.sound: a hall clock ticking, a page turned slowly

pages.title: The Navigation Inn
pages.bed: a small country canal pub on a quiet evening: a log fire crackling, low talk, glasses, a darts board, a door opening onto the towpath

panels.alt: Pete Garrow behind the bar, drying a glass.
panels.prompt: PETE stands behind the wooden bar of a small country pub, drying a pint glass with a tea towel, looking at the viewer without hurry. Beer pumps with hand-pulls in front of him, brass and low beams behind.
panels.sound: a glass being dried, a beer pump pulled, a fire crackling

panels.alt: A log fire in an old pub fireplace.
panels.prompt: A log fire burning in a wide old stone pub fireplace, horse brasses on the beam above, a dog asleep on the rug.
panels.sound: a log fire crackling, a dog sighing

tiny.prompt: Locked-off camera, almost a still photograph. Only the flames of the log fire move. No camera movement.

panels.alt: Night: a lane rising to a small car park by a lock, where a green estate car stands with its lights off.
panels.prompt: Night, from the back door of a pub: wheelie bins in the foreground, a narrow lane rising to a small gravel car park beside a canal lock cottage, where a dark green estate car stands with its lights off. A single street lamp. Mist.
panels.sound: wheelie bins rolled over gravel, a night breeze, an owl

panels.alt: The Navigation Inn by the bottom lock, at dusk.
panels.prompt: A small whitewashed canal pub with a painted sign reading THE NAVIGATION beside the bottom lock of a flight, at dusk, warm light in the windows, a bench and a chalkboard outside.
panels.sound: a pub door opening and closing, voices inside, a canal at dusk

pages.title: The coroner's office
pages.bed: a small office in a market town: a kettle, rain on a window, a phone ringing, traffic below, a radiator ticking

panels.alt: A small coroner's office above a solicitor's: a desk, files, a kettle, a window.
panels.prompt: A small cluttered coroner's office upstairs in an old market-town building: a desk with stacked buff folders, a desk phone, a kettle and mugs on a filing cabinet, a window onto a wet car park.
panels.sound: a radiator ticking, a kettle coming to the boil, rain on a window

tiny.prompt: Locked-off camera, almost a still photograph. Only rain runs down the window and steam rises slowly from the kettle spout. No camera movement.

panels.alt: A desk phone on speaker beside a notepad of handwritten notes.
panels.prompt: Close-up of an old office desk phone with its speaker light on, beside a lined notepad with a few lines of handwritten notes, too small to read, and a biro.
panels.sound: a desk phone ringing, a speakerphone click, a station announcement faint on the line

panels.alt: DS Sam Adeyemi at the office door with a box of pastries.
panels.prompt: SAM stands in an office doorway holding a white cardboard box of pastries, polite and a little awkward, kind.
panels.sound: a door opening, a cardboard box set down, a man clearing his throat

panels.alt: Rain on the office window, and the wet roofs of the market town.
panels.prompt: Through a rain-streaked sash window: the wet slate roofs and church tower of a Cotswold market town under a grey sky.
panels.sound: rain on a window, traffic on a wet street, a church clock striking

pages.title: The top gate
pages.bed: beside a canal lock: water seeping through gates, a light wind, a wren singing, the creak of a balance beam

panels.alt: The top gate of lock fourteen, with new black paint on its balance beam.
panels.prompt: The top gate of a canal lock seen from the lockside: a heavy oak gate with a long balance beam freshly painted glossy black and white, the lock full of still water. Autumn leaves on the coping stones.
panels.sound: water seeping through lock gates, a balance beam creaking, a wren

panels.alt: Under scraped black paint, an old cast iron maker's plate reading HOLLINS 1987, and two plugged bolt holes below.
panels.prompt: Extreme close-up of the end of an oak lock-gate beam where glossy new black paint has been scraped back with a blade in a rough square, showing an old cast iron maker's plate with raised letters reading HOLLINS 1987. Below it, two round wooden plugs in the timber, painted over.
panels.sound: a blade scraping paint, a fingertip on iron

panels.alt: The paddle post of the lock, wrapped in a chain with a brass padlock, its spindle bright with new grease.
panels.prompt: Close-up of an iron canal lock paddle post: a heavy chain wrapped round it and locked with a brass padlock, the square spindle at the top bright with fresh black grease, and a smear of the same grease on the chain.
panels.sound: a chain shifting on iron, a padlock tapping

panels.alt: The stretch of canal up to lock fifteen, the work boat by the bank.
panels.prompt: A stretch of canal between two locks seen along the towpath, the next lock up the hill in the distance, a small blue steel work boat moored by the bank. Willows, fallen leaves on the water, October.
panels.sound: water trickling over a weir, leaves on water, a coot

pages.title: The case board
pages.bed: inside a parked car by a canal: rain on the roof, a heater fan, a pen on paper, a distant moorhen

panels.alt: Ros Kettering in her car, a notebook open on the steering wheel.
panels.prompt: ROS sits in the driver's seat of a small parked hatchback, a notebook open on the steering wheel, writing, reading glasses on, rain on the windscreen.
panels.sound: a pen on paper, rain on a car roof, a heater fan

panels.alt: Index cards taped to the back of a car seat, with handwritten notes.
panels.prompt: Close-up of the back of a car seat with white index cards taped to it in rows, each with a few words of handwriting too small to read, a roll of tape on the seat, a pen.
panels.sound: tape pulled from a roll, a card pressed down

panels.alt: An open notebook of handwritten notes on a car seat.
panels.prompt: An open spiral notebook on a car passenger seat, pages of quick handwritten notes too small to read, a pen in the spiral, a takeaway coffee cup in the holder.
panels.sound: pages turning, a pen clicked

panels.alt: The flight of locks at dusk, seen from the car park.
panels.prompt: A flight of canal locks climbing a valley at dusk, seen from a small gravel car park through a car windscreen with raindrops, lights in a lock cottage window, mist on the water.
panels.sound: rain on a windscreen, a car engine ticking as it cools, a distant owl

tiny.prompt: Locked-off camera, almost a still photograph. Only the raindrops on the windscreen run slowly down and the lit cottage window glows. No camera movement.

pages.title: Wyke Hill
pages.bed: a quiet hillside house: a clock, a garden in wind, a car door, distant sheep

panels.alt: The last house on Wyke Hill, a green estate car on the drive, the flight of locks below in the valley.
panels.prompt: A neat stone house at the end of a hillside lane, a dark green estate car with a small sticker in its rear window on the gravel drive, and far below in the valley a flight of canal locks. October afternoon.
panels.sound: wind in a hedge, sheep in the distance, gravel underfoot

panels.alt: Accounts laid out on a dining table, every column neat, a pair of reading glasses on top.
panels.prompt: Close-up of a polished dining table with ledgers and printed accounts laid out neatly in a row, columns of figures too small to read, a pair of rimless reading glasses folded on top, a fountain pen.
panels.sound: a clock ticking, pages straightened on a table

panels.alt: Clive Amory at his door in a cardigan, reading glasses pushed up.
panels.prompt: CLIVE stands in the doorway of his house wearing a grey cardigan instead of his fleece, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead, polite and welcoming, one hand on the door.
panels.sound: a front door opening, a man's polite greeting breath

panels.alt: An open car boot: a fleece, a first-aid box, wellingtons and a windlass with a worn wooden grip.
panels.prompt: The open boot of a green estate car: a folded navy fleece, a green first-aid box, a pair of muddy wellington boots, and an iron canal windlass with a worn wooden grip, its square socket packed with fresh black grease.
panels.sound: a car boot opening, a windlass clinking on metal

pages.title: Monday
pages.bed: a small office early on a Monday: a kettle, papers, a wall clock, traffic starting below, a knock at the door

panels.alt: The coroner's office on Monday morning, a card folder on the desk.
panels.prompt: The same small coroner's office early on a Monday morning: a buff card folder on the desk with three typed sheets and white index cards clipped to the back, a mug of tea, low sun through the window.
panels.sound: a wall clock ticking, a folder set down, a knock at a door

panels.alt: DCI Quaile reading the file in silence, in her raincoat.
panels.prompt: QUAILE sits on the visitor's chair of a small office still in her raincoat, reading a typed report in a buff folder in silence, one index card turned over in her other hand.
panels.sound: a page turned, a card turned over, a long silence with a clock

panels.alt: A typed report in three parts, a pen, and a hand ready to sign.
panels.prompt: Close-up of a typed report on a desk with three short numbered headings, the text too small to read, a woman's hand holding a fountain pen above the signature line.
panels.sound: a pen on paper, a page squared on a desk

panels.alt: Clive Amory in an interview room, reading glasses on, a solicitor beside him who has stopped writing.
panels.prompt: CLIVE sits at a table in a plain police interview room, reading glasses on, hands folded, speaking quietly, a solicitor in a suit beside him with a pen held still over a legal pad. Grey light.
panels.sound: a recording machine hum, a chair creaking, a quiet room
